==Notes==
*Does not heal spirits. Does heal minions.
*All [[action]]s (including skill activations, attacks, and movement) will be [[cancel]]ed when this form ends.
*This form uses female [[monk]] animations, regardless of your [[character]]'s gender or profession.
*The [[hero]] [[M.O.X.]] has a unique model for this form.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
* Assuming the attribute ranks are the same, the healing of this skill is the exact same as the healing from [[Dwayna's Sorrow]].
